title: LiteAgensh YAML run configuration
description: Initialization input. Relative paths resolve from this YAML file's directory. The resolved configuration and Markdown goal are saved in run state.

repositoryPath.description: Target Git checkout. Worktrees preserve the owner's checkout, not host permissions.

statePath.description: New owned run directory, outside the target checkout. Use a distinct directory for each run.

campaignLedgerPath.description: Persistent credit ledger outside the checkout. Reuse it across runs in the same campaign; do not reset it to bypass uncertain usage.

goalFile.description: Path to a nonempty Markdown goal shared by all workers. The entire file is loaded once at init.

baseRevision.description: Git revision to start from. Not resolved as a file path.

workerCount.description: Equal peers sharing one goal and cooperation template, not permanently assigned roles.

workerStartIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between ordinary worker admissions. Zero preserves immediate eligibility; a positive interval starts native workers gradually while admitted peers cooperate. Waiting time remains inside durationSeconds.

planningSeconds.description: Initial planning interval, no longer than durationSeconds. Zero starts peers without a privileged initial planner.

nativeExecutable.description: Existing Copilot CLI executable or path; not made relative to the YAML file.

nativeArguments.description: Only one reasoning-effort setting is admitted. Transport, authentication and limits remain host-owned.

nativeModel.description: Optional existing native model selection. Omit to keep the native default.

nativePermissionPolicy.description: trusted explicitly permits native tool use on this host. Worktrees are not a security sandbox.

runAiCreditAllowance.description: Run credit circuit breaker, including paid calibration. Native soft caps can overshoot in-flight.

creditAllocation.description: Shared mode draws renewable native spending windows from the run/campaign pool instead of fixed equal worker shares. In-flight native responses can still overshoot.

campaignAiCreditAllowance.description: Persistent campaign circuit breaker; must be at least runAiCreditAllowance.

candidateChecks.description: Checks of submitted changes, executed in the candidate checkout.

finalChecks.description: Checks of final delivery. Configure checks suitable for the target repository.

requirePeerReview.description: Require another peer's review of the exact submitted head.

protectedPaths.description: Protected repository path patterns, not configuration-relative file paths.

createRepository.description: Explicitly allow creating the target repository instead of requiring an existing checkout.

executable.description: Executable used in the check checkout, not resolved relative to this YAML file.
